reviews.comment: Professor Robertson was one of the best professors I have had. He made POLS 432 interesting, engaging, and fun. His humor and personality made every class enjoyable while still teaching the material effectively. If you pay attention in class and keep up with the material, you will do very well on the exams. Highly recommend!
literally so easy. He lets u make up pop quizzes. There are a  couple of take-home quizzes and one final essay. Also does honors course contracts. hes soo nice.

Look, I got my A, and it was not that hard, but this guy is a rambler. His lectures are extremely disorganized but attendance is not mandatory, and slides are posted online. Class was graded 4 quizzes (10%), a midterm, a final, and a paper. each worth 30%.

Take this class. SUPER easy A, but you have to go to class. Not because it's mandatory, but he gives pop quizzes and because he gives you the exam answers in class as a reward for showing up. He's very clear about it, and I just sit in the back and watch Netflix on my iPad. He says crazy things sometimes, but he's super nice. He will cold call.
reviews.ratingTags: Beware of pop quizzes--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Robertson was a fantastic professor; his grading was a little wonky at first, but you get used to it. He has one long essay at the end of the semester but has 4 pop quizzes, which he gives you the answers to, and his exams are take-home with a group if you choose to take it with one. All in all, a super easy professor and nice guy.

Robertson is very chill and super easy. He definitely likes to yap. If you were happy with your grade in the class you didn't have to take the final. Super easy grader. If you go to class he will randomly give answers to questions on the next exams.
I love prof Robertson so much. He lectures all classes and there are 4 pop quizzes that are easy. The essays and tests are take home. He does not use Canvas. He is old school.
reviews.ratingTags: Lecture heavy--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: This class is an easy A but you have to show up.There's 3 quizzes and one essay based off a book but it's an easy read and easy essay if you don't procrastinate. He gives a thorough review of the quizzes. He's also holds himself accountable for falling behind in lectures so he'll only put what he covers on the quizzes which are open book anyway…

Was this class an easy A? Sure, but sitting through his lectures was a really mixed bag. He spends a lot of his lecture time ranting about European politics with thinly veneered attacks on conservative people and conservative values. He acts like these are "neutral observations", but when he raises his voice in a mocking tone its pretty obvious.

Dr. Robertson is a caring and smart man. He cares about his students and wants you to succeed. Dr. Robertson does often get side tracked during lecture, but he is usually entertaining and you'll learn more than you think you are. Class is based on 2 take-home quizzes (must go to lecture for some answers) and 2 book reports. Good class overall.
reviews.ratingTags: Test heavy--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: This will be the easiest 400 level course you will ever take. His lectures could be a bit confusing sometimes, but he really just wants you to understand the general gist of the EU. As long as you attend his lectures, you will be fine. There are two tests, both worth 20% a piece and there's two really long essays that are both worth 30% a piece.
reviews.ratingTags: Clear grading criteria--So many papers--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Very strange professor. Went to most lectures this semester but honestly didn't get much out of how much time I spent listening too him. Very easy A. Professor is unprofessional and has no structure often to his lectures. Can hardly make it through a slide without rambling. Not boring, just didn't learn much for going 3 hours a week.

Dr. Robertson is an amazing professor. If you take his class, you will learn a lot of helpful information. Dr. Robertson is more worried about you learning content than your grade, so if you put in the work you will get an A. Lectures are not required, but I highly recommend showing up and participating. He will remember you in a good way.

Great personality. He is very detailed in his lectures but does not follow an outline so it can get overwhelming. You have to write 2 8-10 page papers over 2 books throughout the semester which was time consuming but he grades essays very easily (half the class got 100s). 2 take home quizzes he gives most the answers to if you go to class.
Amazing man I would take his 432 and 322 classes!
Take home quizzes and a super clear, formulaic paper that he grades easily on. Everyone in my class got an A. He is also a great lecturer and funny.
reviews.ratingTags: Clear grading criteria--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I recommend you take him if you want to take 432. There's a ton of information on his slides, so I recommend you summarize what he says and the slides. 3 quizzes and they are open note and book. He can sometimes ramble and get off track so it is important to sort out what parts he says that are important. Book essay at the end of the semester.

One of the easiest classes I've taken in college, but I got to learn a lot. If you go to class half the time and the 2 lectures before the quiz, you'll do great. Start reading the book for the book report about a month before the paper is due. Ask questions, Dr. Robertson is very knowledgable in his field.

He is so knowledgeable, go to class, it's very interesting! The class is based on 3 quizzes, 50% from PowerPoint 50% from questions he gives you in class, plus a book report (40% of grade). The book report is 2500 words on a 400-page book and the most work of the class. You'll learn a lot by going to class without having to do pointless homework.

Class was always fun to attend. We often went off topic but our class really enjoyed what he lectured over anyway. The "covid syllabus" ended this semester meaning the grade is based on 3 take-home open note quizzes (20% each) and a book report essay (40%). If you come to class for the blended questions the days before the quiz, you will do well.

Dr. Robertson is a great professor! He is really passionate and knowledgable about European Politics. Attendance wasn't required and the lectures were very interesting. I would definitely take him for another class!

Professor Robertson is a great, funny guy. I would take any class he teaches. Quizzes can be tricky because the answers require an understanding of the material, not just a definition. Students who skipped class missed out because he is really smart.

Honestly one of the best professors I've had. Took him for an honors course and actually really enjoyed his teachings which sometimes got a bit boring but he did a great job of explaining things and I definitely learned a lot. Pretty much every class was watching a documentary and then writing a paper about it with a few group projects. Great class
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Hilarious

reviews.comment: He is the best! So passionate about what he teaches and has a lot of outside knowledge and experiences that spice up his lectures (he lectures the entire class with a powerpoint). He is also the most understanding and caring Professor I have had, especially during the pandemic. No tests just 5 quizzes throughout the semester.

Dr. Robertson was an amazing professor. We are currently in the COVID pandemic, learning from home, and he was extremely sensitive to the reality that not all students have equally accommodating living situations at the moment. He went out of his way to interact with students outside of class and make sure that we stayed on track.

Dr. Robertson is arguably the best professor at A&M. I've taken several of his courses & went on one of his study abroad programs (highly recommend). He is extremely knowledgable & passionate about both domestic & foreign politics, & enjoys discussions with students. Your knowledge will go beyond the syllabus & you'll have a great time, guaranteed.
The best professor I've had so far. He is very knowledgeable about European Politics . He is also very funny!
Professor Robertson is a well rounded professor. As long as you try in his class you will be fine. He will make sure you do well if you work with him

One of the best and most hilarious professors I have ever had! Every class is interesting and he keeps us laughing and into the topic of discussion. Easiest class I have ever taken. I wish I could have him for every single class!!! TAKE HIM!

He is very erratic with his lectures and often strays from the main topic, but I have never learned so much because he gives his honest thoughts and experiences rather than read from a book. The books he recommends are keepers if you are interested in international politics.
Love this prof, plan on taking him for every class I can.

One of the most hilarious professors I've ever had. I took his class fall 2016 so he had a lot to say about the election and it was really enlightening. He gives a lot of homework (all group work) and presentations but he realizes you are likely forced to take this class and that it isn't your priority.
Professor Robertson is hilarious. His lectures are entertaining, and he definitely interacts with the class a lot. He is so "real" and honestly one of the most fun professors I've ever had.

Best professor I've had at TAMU and the best in POLS department by far! He truly cares about your success. His lectures are fun and entertaining. Actually learning material that is relevant. He is an easy grader and gives a few pop quizzes, but allows you to make them up. He is hysterical. TAKE HIM!!!

Loved, loved, loved this course. Full of engaging discussion. JRob is so interesting and offers fresh insight into the U.S. political arena. More than just a government course. Gets students to think.

I am in the honors section of 206, and this class has been great. Your grade is determined by a series of presentations and papers that are due throughout the semester, however his grading is not very difficult. He looks primarily to see if you have an understanding of the reading that week. Also, his lectures are hilarious.

Honestly came into POLS 206 expecting to be bored out my mind, being a STEM major, but Dr. Robertson knew that most of his students weren't Pols majors, and he really was very caring that we actually learned something.  The class was honors, and we read a ton, but overall he was good. (He does tend to go on rants but they're not really that bad)
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--GROUP PROJECTS

reviews.comment: Class is lecture based, and his lectures can be pretty entertaining just because he tends to go on long, funny tangents about things. Grades consist of 3 short papers, 3 quizzes, 2 tests, and 1 10 page paper. He's pretty lenient on grading, but the tests are hard (fill in the blank/essay) and you shouldn't blow them off. Overall, great professor!
